name: Evo Design And Constructions
longDescription: We built a professional portfolio site for Evo Design And Constructions, highlighting ongoing and completed projects, service offerings, and client testimonials with a polished visual identity.

name: Cafe Raaga
shortDescription: A cozy destination for soulful food and ambience.
longDescription: Cafe Raaga blends food and atmosphere into a memorable experience. The project involved branding, a dynamic menu display system, and a responsive website that reflects its modern and vibrant identity.

name: ChattadaSrivaishnava
longDescription: We developed an informative and spiritually enriched website to connect members of the Srivaishnava community. It features event updates, blog articles, donation integration, and prayer schedules.

name: SpeedCopy
shortDescription: Smart document printing and scanning on the go.
longDescription: SpeedCopy is a mobile-first platform for on-demand printing, scanning, and delivery. Users can upload documents and place print orders from anywhere. Features include payment integration and real-time tracking.

name: Jaasritha Corporate Solutions
shortDescription: Enterprise solutions for smart city infrastructure.
longDescription: We designed and implemented a centralized dashboard for Jaasritha Corporate Solutions. The solution includes analytics, IoT device integrations, and resource tracking modules tailored for smart city needs.

name: RURA Foundation
longDescription: RURA Foundation's platform features donation management, volunteer registration, and impact tracking. We built a robust website to support their community-driven mission and outreach efforts.

name: Decorsin
longDescription: Decorsin’s platform showcases interior design collections, client stories, and catalog browsing. The solution integrates a CMS for easy content updates and inquiry capture tools.

name: Spreading Smiles Foundation
shortDescription: Helping communities smile with digital support.
longDescription: We developed a portal to support Spreading Smiles Foundation's programs, donations, and community engagement. It includes impact stories, volunteer forms, and a photo gallery.

name: Shanvi Constructions
longDescription: Shanvi Constructions’ website is a showcase of civil projects, company certifications, and a clean contact portal. Designed for SEO and mobile-first browsing experience.

name: UniStacx Academy
longDescription: We built a scalable LMS for UniStacx Academy with features like video lessons, quizzes, certification, and admin tools. Built to support learners in coding, design, and entrepreneurship.

name: SpeedCopy (Old)
longDescription: The legacy version of SpeedCopy laid the foundation for mobile-based document services. It included core upload, preview, and payment features with a minimal backend.
